title: Mean-Lp Risk-Constrained Reinforcement Learning: Primal-Dual Policy Gradient and Augmented MDP Approaches

contributions.purpose: 为一般 Lp 风险约束 RL 提供带全局收敛保证的无模型算法
contributions.mechanism: Lagrangian 松弛+原始-对偶策略梯度,策略与乘子交替更新
contributions.evaluation: 理论 O~(1/eps^2) 样本复杂度达 eps-最优 eps-可行,匹配已知最优率;gridworld 中约 500±100 episodes 收敛
contributions.source_quote: Primal-Dual Policy Gradient Algorithm: We develop a Lagrangian-based policy optimization method (Algorithm 1) that provably converges to an optimal policy under convexity assumptions... Notably, this is the first algorithm with global convergence guarantees for RL under a nonlinear Lp risk constraint.

contributions.purpose: 得到严格不违约的安全策略作为可靠基线
contributions.mechanism: 把剩余成本预算 kappa 增广进状态,构造增广 MDP 后做值迭代,超预算动作被禁
contributions.evaluation: 零约束违反(满足 rho_inf 准则),大 p 时近似最优;实验中约 800±150 episodes 收敛,策略偏保守(p=2 风险约 0.25 vs 上限 0.3)
contributions.source_quote: Augmented State Dynamic Programming: We propose a model-based planning algorithm (Algorithm 2) that exactly enforces the risk constraint by augmenting the MDP state with the remaining cost budget.

contributions.purpose: 把风险敏感 RL 从 CVaR/方差特例推广到任意阶 p 并实证验证风险-收益权衡
contributions.mechanism: 以 p 为旋钮在风险中性(p=1)与最坏情形(p→∞)间插值,在 5x5 gridworld 上对 p∈{1,2,4,8}评测
contributions.evaluation: 两算法均满足约束;p 从 1 到 8 平均回报由约 0.9 降至 0.6-0.7,风险随 p 单调下降
contributions.source_quote: Broader Implications: Our framework handles any risk order p >= 1, significantly generalizing prior risk-averse RL methods that focused on variance or CVaR-based criteria.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our results provide the first general-purpose algorithms for Lp-risk-constrained RL, generalizing prior approaches that were limited to CVaR or variance-based risk.
The key idea, inspired by state augmentation for safe exploration [16], is to incorporate the remaining "risk budget" into the state.
Algorithm 1 essentially implements a constrained policy optimization in the spirit of prior safe RL methods but extended to a nonlinear Lp risk metric.
This method is related to approaches in safe exploration research such as the "Saute RL" framework by [17], which augments state with a continuously decaying budget to ensure almost-sure safety.

notes: 论文有编号贡献列表(3 条)。trade-off 数据充分:样本效率 PD-PG 约 500±100 vs Aug-MDP 约 800±150 episodes;安全性反向,PD-PG 训练早期有约束违反而 Aug-MDP 构造上零违反但更保守(p=2 风险 0.25 vs PD-PG 0.29,上限 0.3);回报随 p 增大从 0.9 降到 0.6-0.7。实验仅 5x5 toy gridworld,checklist 自认不报 error bars(第 7 项答 No)。AI 参与度自报:选题人类[A],实验/分析/写作全 AI[D];Observed AI Limitations 自承'resulting algorithms and methods are very shallow'且 AI 无法在 MuJoCo 等标准环境实现测试,仅能做 gridworld。
